options.html: Poet, investor, counsel to founders. Bangalore and New York.
I make poems, photographs, tools and companies, and I am learning Kathak. One of each.

I write poems, and most days I build software. The poems came first. The software is newer, and it is mostly tools to support myself: one place where everything I leave behind lands, a day planned from it, and a public record of what got built. The photograph and poem on the home page come out of the same machine, one of each a day.

Most days I build software with Claude: tools to support myself, worked out from what I already leave behind, so they almost never have to ask. One place everything lands, a day planned from it, and a public record of what got built each week.
nowBuilding software with Claude most days: tools to support myself, worked out from what I already leave behind. The record is public.

I run a storytelling studio, Joyus, with Divya Tak. I invest early with Sweta and Sahil at Tres Monos Capital, sit on the board of TomboyX, and keep a few standing slots for founders in the middle of something that matters. Before that I ran Vidyanext in Bangalore. When it could not be saved, I placed all 65+ people in two months.

Joyus is a storytelling and experience design studio with Divya Tak. Tres Monos invests early in underrepresented founders, with Sweta Jagirdar and Sahil Sagar. At Vidyanext, in Bangalore, I took over after a leadership crisis; when it could not be saved, I placed all 65+ people within two months.

How the World Works, a first book, 2022. 97 poems on this site since, and one a day on the home page, chosen by the day’s weather. An MFA in Writing and Poetics underway at the Jack Kerouac School, Naropa.
